title: Lake Nazferiti
wikitext:
[[Image:Lake Nazferiti.jpg|thumb|300px|Lake Nazferiti]]
'''Lake Nazferiti''' is a lake in [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. Bordering it is a [[Venture Co. Base Camp|large base]] of the [[goblin]] [[Venture Company]]. It features many [[Frenzy|frenzies]] and [[crocolisk]]s in its waters. [[Nazferiti river]], which flows through the lake, may be the longest on the southern [[Eastern Kingdoms]] with a confirmed source at a waterfall in [[Redridge Mountains]] and unconfirmed headwaters within [[Deadwind Pass]].
